# Argentum Splat

> Free, open-source Cinema 4D 2027 plugin for Windows: local single-image-to-3D Gaussian generation with TripoSplat, scan import and Redshift card rendering. Maintained by OlehandroStox / ARGENTUM.

## Documentation

- [Overview and quick start](https://github.com/OlehandroStox/argentum-splat/blob/main/README.md)
- [Russian guide](https://github.com/OlehandroStox/argentum-splat/blob/main/README.ru.md)
- [Controls](https://github.com/OlehandroStox/argentum-splat/blob/main/docs/controls.md)
- [Installation](https://github.com/OlehandroStox/argentum-splat/blob/main/docs/installation.md)

- [Third-party licenses](https://github.com/OlehandroStox/argentum-splat/blob/main/ArgentumSplat/backend/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

## Compatibility facts

Version 0.5.0 is an experimental preview using development plugin IDs 1000007–1000009; ID conflicts are possible. Install.cmd installs a private Python and dependencies automatically. Local AI needs an NVIDIA Ampere-or-newer BF16-capable CUDA GPU and driver. Tested on Windows / C4D 2027.0.0 / RTX 4070 12 GB. Redshift is required for the documented rendering workflow. Native PLY/SPLAT/SPZ v2/v3 import does not need AI weights.

Generation takes one image or one selected video/sequence frame and outputs one static model, up to 262,144 Gaussians, SH0. It is not multi-view reconstruction, photogrammetry, animated 4D generation, a watertight mesh, hair grooming or physical eye reconstruction. Imported SH1–SH3 is supported when present. Redshift rendering uses Gaussian cards, not a native Gaussian rasterizer. Public source is MIT; dependencies and model components have separate licenses. Optional tips: https://boosty.to/olehandrostox .
